definition: a doctor who provides general, ongoing care to you and your family
example: Many British Columbians still do not have a family doctor.

definition: a medical clinic where you can see a doctor without an appointment
vi: phòng khám không cần hẹn trước
example: I waited three hours at the walk-in clinic just to get a prescription renewed.

definition: to arrange a time to see a doctor or other professional
example: You can book an appointment online or by calling the clinic after 8 a.m.
collocations: book an appointment with a doctor

definition: a doctor's written order for medicine
example: The pharmacist said my prescription could be refilled two more times.

definition: a trained professional who prepares and sells medicines and gives advice
example: In BC, a pharmacist can now prescribe medication for some minor conditions.

definition: (of medicine) able to be bought without a prescription
example: For a mild headache, an over-the-counter painkiller is usually enough.

definition: signs of an illness that a person feels or notices
example: If your symptoms get worse after three days, see a doctor.

definition: unwanted effects of a medicine or treatment
example: Common side effects of this medication include drowsiness and dry mouth.

definition: insurance that pays for medical care
vi: bảo hiểm y tế, phạm vi chi trả y tế
example: New residents may have to wait up to three months before their provincial health coverage starts.

definition: a doctor's request sending a patient to see a specialist
vi: giấy giới thiệu (chuyển tuyến) đến bác sĩ chuyên khoa
example: You need a referral from your family doctor to see a dermatologist.

definition: a doctor with advanced training in one area of medicine
example: The wait to see a specialist in Vancouver can be several months.

definition: how long people must wait for a service, such as surgery
example: The province plans to hire more nurses to reduce emergency room wait times.

definition: the part of a hospital that treats urgent injuries and illnesses
example: We took my father to the emergency room when he had chest pain.

definition: a general medical examination to make sure you are healthy
example: I go to the dentist for a check-up and cleaning every six months.

definition: treatment of injuries using exercise, massage and movement
example: After my back injury, my extended benefits paid for ten sessions of physiotherapy.

definition: a person's emotional and psychological well-being
example: The company now offers free counselling to support employees' mental health.
collocations: take care of your mental health

definition: workplace insurance that covers costs not paid by the government, like dental or massage
vi: phúc lợi y tế bổ sung (bảo hiểm sức khỏe mở rộng)
example: My extended health benefits cover 80 percent of the cost of new glasses.

definition: to receive a vaccine to protect against a disease
example: Seniors are encouraged to get vaccinated against the flu every fall.

definition: (of an illness or problem) lasting a long time or keeping coming back
example: Many people with chronic back pain find relief through regular exercise.

definition: to become healthy again after an illness or injury
example: It took me nearly a month to recover from knee surgery.

definition: feeling slightly ill
example: I'm feeling a bit under the weather, so I'll work from home today.

definition: to injure a joint, like an ankle, by twisting it suddenly
example: She slipped on the icy sidewalk and sprained her ankle.

definition: having a bad physical reaction to a particular substance
example: Please tell the nurse if you are allergic to any medication.

definition: a later visit to check on progress after treatment
example: The doctor asked me to book a follow-up appointment in two weeks.

definition: a record of a person's past illnesses and treatments
example: New patients must fill out a form about their medical history.

definition: a way of living that includes good food, exercise and enough sleep
example: Maintaining a healthy lifestyle is easier when your workplace has a gym.

definition: extreme tiredness and stress caused by working too hard for too long
vi: kiệt sức (do làm việc quá sức)
example: Doctors warn that long shifts without breaks can lead to burnout among nurses.

definition: a short letter from a doctor confirming that someone was ill
vi: giấy xác nhận của bác sĩ (giấy nghỉ ốm)
example: My employer asked for a doctor's note after I missed a full week of work.

definition: a nurse with advanced training who can diagnose and prescribe
vi: y tá cấp cao (được chẩn đoán và kê đơn)
example: Patients without a family doctor can register with a nurse practitioner at the new clinic.

definition: a situation where there are not enough doctors
example: Small towns in northern BC have been hit hardest by the doctor shortage.

definition: (of a pharmacist) to prepare and give out the medicine a doctor has prescribed
vi: lấy thuốc theo đơn, bán thuốc theo toa
example: I dropped off my prescription, and the pharmacy filled it in about twenty minutes.
collocations: fill a prescription at the pharmacy

definition: a medical test in which a small amount of blood is taken and checked
example: My doctor sent me for a blood test before our next appointment.
collocations: send someone for a blood test

definition: pain or discomfort in the throat, often caused by a cold
example: I woke up with a sore throat and a runny nose, so I stayed home from work.

definition: to start to have a minor illness
example: Half of my son's class seems to come down with the flu every January.

definition: an injection that helps protect you against the flu
example: Many local pharmacies offer flu shots every fall.

definition: a substance taken to treat or prevent an illness
example: Please bring a list of every medication you take to your appointment.

definition: an official card that shows you are registered for public health care
example: The receptionist asked to see my health card before I could see the doctor.

definition: simple medical help given to someone who is hurt or ill before a doctor arrives
example: Every camp counsellor must know basic first aid.

definition: the force of your blood pushing against the walls of your blood vessels, often checked by a doctor, nurse or pharmacist
example: The pharmacist checked my blood pressure while I waited for my prescription.

definition: the amount of a medicine that you should take and how often
example: Always follow the dosage on the label, and ask the pharmacist if you are unsure.

definition: to become completely healthy again after an illness or injury
example: Doctors expect him to make a full recovery after the surgery.
collocations: expect to make a full recovery
make a full and speedy recovery

definition: to ask another doctor or expert to check a diagnosis or advice
vi: tham khảo ý kiến của bác sĩ khác
example: If you are not comfortable with the diagnosis, it is reasonable to get a second opinion.

definition: to identify what illness or problem someone has
example: She was diagnosed with asthma when she was a child.

definition: a new supply of a medicine that has already been prescribed
vi: đợt lấy thêm thuốc (theo đơn cũ)
example: You can order a refill online and pick it up the next day.

definition: a medical appointment by phone or video call instead of in person
vi: buổi khám từ xa (qua điện thoại hoặc video)
example: My doctor offers virtual appointments for simple follow-ups.

definition: to be officially accepted into a hospital as a patient who stays there
example: My grandmother was admitted to hospital with a high fever last night.

definition: to be officially allowed to leave a hospital after treatment
example: He was discharged after two days and told to rest at home.

definition: the information you receive after a medical test
example: The clinic will call you when your test results come back.

definition: a medicine that reduces or stops pain
example: I took a painkiller for my headache and lay down for an hour.

definition: to injure a muscle by stretching it too much
example: I pulled a muscle in my back while lifting boxes during the move.
collocations: pull a muscle in your back

definition: able to spread from one person to another
example: Please keep your child home while they are still contagious.

definition: an area of red spots or irritation on the skin
example: She developed a rash after trying a new laundry detergent.

definition: to drink enough water so your body does not lose too much fluid
example: On hot summer days, health officials remind everyone to stay hydrated.

definition: a clinic that treats injuries and illnesses that need quick care but are not life-threatening
vi: trung tâm khám chữa bệnh cấp thiết (không nguy hiểm tính mạng)
example: Instead of going to the ER, we took him to the urgent care centre for his sprained wrist.
collocations: go to an urgent care centre

definition: professional help and advice for personal or emotional problems
example: The college offers free counselling to students who feel stressed or anxious.

definition: an appointment you can book and attend on the same day
example: The clinic keeps a few same-day appointments for patients who call early in the morning.

definition: to have a wound closed with special thread by a doctor or nurse
example: My daughter cut her knee on the playground and had to get stitches.

definition: to eat, drink or use less of something
example: My doctor advised me to cut down on salt and sugar.

definition: health care that aims to stop illnesses before they start or get serious
example: Regular check-ups are an important part of preventive care.

definition: a health problem that a person already has and that can make other illnesses worse
example: People with an underlying condition such as diabetes should talk to their doctor before travelling.

definition: medical tests that check healthy people for signs of a disease
example: The health authority encourages adults over a certain age to go for regular cancer screening.

definition: (of an illness or pain) to suddenly become worse again
vi: tái phát, bùng lên trở lại
example: My allergies always flare up in the spring when the trees start to bloom.

definition: a document you sign to show you agree to a medical procedure or activity
vi: giấy đồng ý, phiếu chấp thuận
example: Before the procedure, the nurse asked me to read and sign a consent form.

definition: involving a lot of sitting and little physical activity
example: Office workers with a sedentary job should try to take short walks during the day.

definition: the state of being healthy, comfortable and happy
vi: sức khỏe và hạnh phúc, sự an lạc
example: Spending time outdoors has a positive effect on our mental and physical well-being.

definition: the parts of your body that fight infection and disease
example: Getting enough sleep helps keep your immune system strong.

definition: in BC, a regional organization that runs public health services and hospitals
vi: cơ quan y tế khu vực
example: The local health authority announced that a new urgent care clinic will open next spring.

definition: a secure website where patients can see test results and messages from their clinic
vi: cổng thông tin bệnh nhân trực tuyến
example: You can check your lab results through the patient portal instead of calling the clinic.

definition: to become ill again after seeming to improve; also a noun for this return of illness
example: Doctors say it is important to finish the treatment so patients do not relapse.

definition: a sudden start of a disease affecting many people
example: The care home limited visitors during a flu outbreak.

definition: rules about what food a person cannot or should not eat for health, religious or personal reasons
vi: các hạn chế về ăn uống, kiêng khem
example: Please let the organizers know about any dietary restrictions or allergies before the event.

definition: the treatment and control of pain over time
example: The physiotherapist and my doctor worked out a pain management plan for my back.

definition: the process of deciding which patients need treatment first based on how serious their condition is
vi: phân loại bệnh nhân theo mức độ khẩn cấp
example: In the emergency department, patients are seen based on triage, not in the order they arrive.

definition: the way a doctor or nurse behaves towards patients
vi: thái độ, cách cư xử với bệnh nhân (của bác sĩ, y tá)
example: Dr. Chen has a wonderful bedside manner and always explains things clearly.

definition: to make pain, a problem or suffering less severe
example: New walk-in clinics may help alleviate pressure on busy emergency rooms.

definition: to become worse
example: The patient's condition began to deteriorate overnight, so the nurse called the doctor.

definition: a harmful or unpleasant effect caused by a medicine or treatment
example: Tell your doctor or pharmacist if you think you are having an adverse reaction to a new medication.
